target.title: refactor(discord): split message process runtime
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Discord message-processing runtime had grown into one 1,358-line orchestration module that mixed reaction lifecycle, reply delivery, draft progress, and queue coordination. That made ownership boundaries hard to audit and kept the file on the grandfathered max-lines list.

## Why This Change Was Made

This behavior-neutral refactor extracts cohesive reaction, reply-runtime, and progress owners while leaving the process entry point responsible for orchestration. Delivery skip diagnostics now live beside delivery diagnostics, with the existing export preserved for callers. The grandfathered max-lines baseline entry is removed.

## User Impact

No user-visible behavior changes. Discord message processing keeps the same reaction, typing, draft-preview, delivery-correlation, and cleanup behavior, with smaller ownership-focused modules for future maintenance.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-handler.process.test.ts extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-handler.process.*.test.ts` — 9 files, 142 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-run-queue.test.ts extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-handler.context.test.ts extensions/discord/src/monitor/reply-delivery.test.ts extensions/discord/src/monitor/reply-typing-feedback.test.ts` — 4 files, 38 tests passed.
- `node scripts/check-changed.mjs -- config/max-lines-baseline.txt extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-handler.process-progress.ts extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-handler.process-reactions.ts extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-handler.process-reply-runtime.ts extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-handler.process.ts extensions/discord/src/monitor/reply-delivery.ts` — hosted changed gate passed, including max-lines ratchet, production/test typechecks, 7,403-file extension lint, and import-cycle guard: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29669122353
- Per-commit structured autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings (0.98 before the final conflict-free rebase; repeated at the rebased commit).
